column1: # Round 2 frames index. Tab-separated; `#` lines are comments.
#   PNG (all of them):  cargo run -p wqm-tui --features png-capture,tui-pantry \
#   grid / ANSI (one):  cargo pantry dump "Modal Framework R2" --variant "<variant>" \
#   browse:             cargo pantry          (Views tab, group "Modal Framework R2")
# Both instruments render the SAME pantry variant, so they cannot disagree about what was
# drawn. Judge COLOUR from the PNG and GLYPHS/ATTRIBUTES from the grid — png-capture drops
# the `●` radio glyph (wqm#283), U+E0B0 is invisible in most text views, and no still image
# theme is Catppuccin Mocha unless the row says otherwise.

column4: what it shows
Item 0: the maximum window — five columns of page each side, five rows top and bottom
The same rule at the floor Chris named: 90x20 window, still 5 of page all round
And on a wide terminal: 190x30. The inset is relative, so nothing is capped
The derived minimum: decoration plus exactly ONE content row. 34x10 window on a 44x20 page
Below the floor: no window at all, and a message that names the size needed and the size present
Item 1a: a window that is not part of a drill-down is as big as its content, capped by the maximum
Item 1b: a drill-down at the maximum with a table that cannot shrink — vertical AND horizontal bars
column5: 04 size — drill-down at max, both bars (B)

column4: THE DEFECT. Blue 0.40 mixed in sRGB: the fill rises to meet the text and the help row washes out
PROPOSED. The same hue at the same strength with L* held: 13/15 themes clear the WCAG body floor
The adversarial theme — the thinnest ladder of the fifteen, where round 1's SET fill fell under a JND
A LIGHT theme, where the ladder runs the other way — the case Mocha alone cannot show
Item 3: VIEW mode, the selected field on the table's own block with black bold text (ruling 7, already shipped)
column5: 09 fields — view mode, black on the cursor row

column4: What Chris objected to: every editable value ruled as well as filled
column5: 10 fields — edit mode, fill and underline (round 1)

column4: PROPOSED. Underline gone, SET carried by the fill, ACTIVE field derived light enough for black text
Item 3: a radio group on ONE row, the active button bold; h/l or arrows move within it
The SAME group as a COLUMN, the whole column highlighted; j/k or arrows move within it
column5: 13 fields — the same radio as a column (B)

column4: Item 3: drop-down open — NO frame, other highlights gone, current value first then sorted
`ts` typed: the list narrows by fuzzy subsequence and the cursor sits on the best match
vim INSERT: a bar caret carrying the real SLOW_BLINK attribute — read it from the grid, not the PNG
column5: 16 fields — single line, vim INSERT (bar, blinking)

column4: vim NORMAL: a block ON a character, and the one caret that does NOT blink
column5: 17 fields — single line, vim NORMAL (block, steady)

column4: EMACS/conventional: the terminal owns the cursor, so nothing is painted — a still frame shows none
A multi-line field being edited: the fill IS the box, so no border is drawn around it
OPEN Q2, arm A: selected text as a neutral inversion — no hue spent
OPEN Q2, arm B: the theme's `secondary` — a real colour, and the data cursor's own hue on 13/15 themes
Item 4: the band Chris removed — the informational column given a surface of its own
column5: 22 readability — third column on its band (round 1)

column4: PROPOSED. No band, and the raised quiet rung makes the column legible on the window
Item 4: headers are optional — no third column, therefore no header row, and that row goes back to data
Item (a) at depth 1: all current, no ancestor run, opening straight off the window
Depth 2: one ancestor and the current crumb, with the transition between them
PROPOSED, depth 3: two ancestors sharing one full-saturation run, separator inside it, current crumb lighter and bold
What it replaces: *not visible enough* — muted text, a faint chevron, no background at all
Item (b): this frame IS in edit mode and nothing on the title row says so
column5: 29 banner — view vs edit, no `-- EDIT --`

column4: Item (c): the window beneath the guard quietened by the SAME ModalScope the page gets
column5: 30 confirm — a window quietened under its own guard

column4: Item (e), round 1: the drawn box in the modal hue
PROPOSED. Same rect, fill and padding, no glyphs — content does not move by a column
Degradation: under NO_COLOR the ladder collapses, so the underline comes back — only here
